text:
sam: Drafting RFC/PRD for prefetch-aware routing + kernel compatibility. Goal: reduce cold-start KV latency and avoid incompatible kernels during fallback. Start here: requirements and acceptance criteria.

lia: High level: customers asking for lower tail latency on long-chat sessions. Need clear rollout gates and perf targets. Which models/workloads to prioritize?

ravi: Requirements:
- Prefetch should populate KV cache for top-k predicted prefixes within 50ms.
- Router must consider kernel ABI compatibility: route only to kernels supporting quant backend for model X.
- Fallback policy: if prefetched or kernel mismatch, fallback to same model family with quantized kernel w/ <2x cost.
- Metrics: p99 token latency, percent of requests with prefetched hit, cost delta per 1M tokens.

olivia: Acceptance criteria proposal:
1) p99 token generation latency improves by >=15% on target workloads (long chats >1024 tokens).
2) Prefetch hit rate >=40% for conversational regimens in canary.
3) No functional regressions (all tests in runtime-integration pass).
4) Fallback correctness: output parity within tolerance for sampling runs.

sam: Edge cases to call out:
- model rollouts where old kernel doesn't support quantized matmul -> must failover gracefully.
- multi-tenant cache pollution (one tenant's prefetch evicting hot keys for another) -> need tenant-aware eviction.

ravi: Proposed rollout steps:
- lab perf eval on perf-cluster (bench harness 2048 seq) -> baseline
- canary 1: 5% traffic on dedicated pool with low variance customers
- monitor perf + quality signals for 48h
- canary 2: 25% + column for heavy long-chat customers
- full: enable with opt-out flag per tenant

olivia: config snippet for router policy:
```
route_policies:
  - name: prefetch-friendly
    prefetch_enabled: true
    kernel_whitelist:
      - kernel: quant-gemm-v2
        models: ["redwood-qa-7b", "open-llama-13b"]
    fallback_behavior: prefer-same-family
    tenant_eviction: lru-tenant-aware
```

lia: QA asks: how do we measure "output parity"? propose percent-token-delta and perplexity drift on eval set.

sam: Good. I'll update the PRD and open RFC draft. @olivia can you add rollout dashboard requirements? @ravi please enumerate testcases (kernel mismatch, prefetch miss, tenant eviction). :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New RFC created: rfc/2048123456-prefetch-routing. Link: https://rdrw.internal/rfcs/2048123456 :rocket:

olivia: Will add dashboards (p99/p50, prefetch_hit_rate, fallback_rate, per-tenant eviction rate). Also include automated regression alert if quality drift >2%.

ravi: I'll add unit+integration tests. Also suggest a kernel compatibility matrix in the RFC with versioned ABI.

sam: Thanks team. Meeting tomorrow 9am to triage acceptance criteria and finalize launch gates. Agenda in calendar.
